property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: Determines where on the local filesystem an DFS data node should store its blocks.

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: Determines where on the local filesystem an DFS name node should store the name table (fsimage).

property.name: dfs.namenode.checkpoint.dir
property.description: Determines where on the local filesystem the DFS secondary name node should store the temporary images to merge. If this is a comma-delimited list of directories then the image is replicated in all of the directories for redundancy.

property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Default block replication. The actual number of replications can be specified when the file is created. The default is used if replication is not specified in create time.

property.name: dfs.hosts
property.description: Names a file that contains a list of hosts that are permitted to connect to the namenode. The full pathname of the file must be specified. If the value is empty, all hosts are permitted.

property.name: dfs.namenode.datanode.registration.ip-hostname-check
property.description: Whether the NameNode checks if the IP address and hostname of DataNodes match during registration. Set to false to disable the check.

property.name: dfs.webhdfs.enabled
property.description: Whether WebHDFS is enabled. If true, WebHDFS will be enabled.

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir.restore
property.description: Whether the NameNode should attempt to restore the name directory from a previous checkpoint if the current name directory is empty. If true, the NameNode will attempt to restore the name directory from a previous checkpoint if the current name directory is empty.

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir.restore.checkpoint
property.description: Whether the NameNode should attempt to restore the name directory from a previous checkpoint if the current name directory is empty. If true, the NameNode will attempt to restore the name directory from a previous checkpoint if the current name directory is empty.

property.name: dfs.blocksize
property.description: The default block size for new files. The actual block size can be specified when the file is created. The default is used if the block size is not specified at create time.
